scripts.build: npm run build:shared && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:production: npm run build && node --import tsx tests/scripts/production-smoke.ts
scripts.test:production:house: npm run build && node --import tsx tests/scripts/production-smoke.ts --house
scripts.test:production:shadow: npm run build && node --import tsx tests/scripts/production-smoke.ts --shadow
scripts.test:production:dealer-bet: npm run build && node --import tsx tests/scripts/production-smoke.ts --dealer-bet
